P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor present; the page relies entirely on typography and abstract graphics.

P05.rationale: The layout contains no case studies with client portraits; it consists of a single headline block and text columns.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as press logos, rating cards, or review grids visible on the page.

P10.rationale: A large '40%' figure acts as a decorative typographic element, though it functions more as data than a ghost numeral.

P11.rationale: The prominent '40%' statistic is bound to specific text ('der großen Unternehmen'), functioning as a real data-visualisation.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and structured columns.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid dark blue color without any intentional texture or atmospheric grain.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos used on this page to require treatment for text readability.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups (like phones or laptops) are shown in the generated image.

N07.rationale: The imagery is non-existent and abstract, which technically avoids generic stock photos but lacks specific business context entirely.

N08.rationale: There is no sparse dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with text columns and a central graphic element.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without scrim because there are no photographs present to create this conflict.
